exact_target: For each integer d >= 3, each iid law P of nearest-neighbour transition rows on Z^d with every one of the 2d probabilities strictly positive almost surely, and each fixed nonzero l in R^d, the annealed probability E_P[P_0^omega(lim_n X_n dot l = +infinity)] belongs to {0,1}.
quantifiers: Every fixed nonzero direction; no assertion of a single quenched null set uniform over uncountably many directions. The environment is sampled once and retained on revisits.
uniformly_elliptic_subtarget: The same assertion under a deterministic positive lower bound on every transition probability. Uniform ellipticity is stronger than strict ellipticity.
